thread:
emma: Heads-up - we got a report from support: model alias swap changed embedding dimensionality for a few legacy models. This surfaces as vector-length mismatches in customer code and some of our sample apps. Need a docs patch + deprecation blurb.

ryan: Ack. Which models are affected?

emma: Preliminary: `redwood-embed-legacy` now maps to `redwood-embed-v2` which is 1536 -> 1024 dims in some regions. I think the swap was for perf, but we should call out the change and provide migration guidance.

zara: I'll prepare a short migration snippet for code that handles vector array lengths. Suggest we add automatic fallback guidance: check dims and re-embed if mismatch. Example snippet: `if resp.embedding.length != EXPECTED_DIM { // re-run with redwood-embed-v1 or pad/truncate }`

ryan: We should avoid recommending pad/truncate lightly; better to recommend re-embedding or mapping models explicitly. Also add a note to pin model aliases in production config.

emma: Agreed. Action items: 1) deprecation note + changelog blurb, 2) snippet showing detection + remediation, 3) update quickstart embed section and client libs.

zara: I'll open PR with changes: replacing ambiguous alias with explicit model IDs in samples and adding a new FAQ entry "Why are my embeddings a different length?"

eng-infra: FYI infra did a regional mapping to route older alias to v2 in eu-west for perf reasons. We can revert mapping if docs/pm requests, but it's a live change.

ryan: Docs must be transparent. Add a timeline and mention that alias behavior can differ by region. Also include a short compatibility shim for the SDKs: JS shim `const dims = resp.embedding?.length; if (dims && dims !== expectedDim) { console.warn(...) }` ; Ruby: `if resp[:embedding].length != expected_dim` etc.

ezra: (note: corrected name to zara)

zara: PR #4899 WIP. I added FAQ and examples, and a one-liner in each language showing the dimension check. Also added a recommended config: `model: redwood-embed-v1@2025-01-15` to pin.

emma: Nice. docs-bot: please ensure `docs-update` label and add to weekly changelog.

docs-bot: Label `docs-update` added. Please include a Customer Impact assessment in PR description.

ryan: For customer comms, let's draft a short email: - What changed (alias mapping -> model swap, dims changed) - Who is affected (anyone using alias without pinning) - Action (pin model or re-embed) - Timeline and contact. Emma can draft and I will review.

emma: I'll draft and post a link here. Also adding a short note to migration guide under embeddings -> "Model aliases and embedding dims" with step-by-step remediation.

zara: Merged #4899. I kept the code examples conservative and added links to the SDK shim examples.

docs-bot: PR #4899 merged by zara. Changelog entry: "Embedding alias swap - guidance on embedding dimension changes and migration steps."

ryan: Emma, can you post the customer comms draft?

emma: Draft posted: https://internal.redwood/comms/drafts/embed-dim-swap. TL;DR included and a short FAQ.

eng-infra: We're scheduling a small rollback window if customers request it within 72 hours. Please escalate via support if needed.

ryan: Ok, closing loop: docs updated, comms drafted, infra has rollback. I'll sync with support to watch tickets. Add this to next week's release notes as well.

emma: Thanks everyone. I'll follow up with a short retrospective on how alias swaps are communicated to docs earlier in the flow.
